Struct ColorRgba

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Color

ShapeEngine.dll

Represents an RGBA color with 8-bit components for red, green, blue, and alpha channels.

public readonly struct ColorRgba : IEquatable<ColorRgba>

ShapeTween.Tween(ColorRgba, ColorRgba, float, TweenType)

Remarks

This immutable struct provides color manipulation, conversion between different color formats, and various utility methods for color transformations. It implements IEquatable for efficient comparison operations and integrates with both System.Drawing.Color and Raylib_cs.Color.

GetRelativeLuminance()

Calculates the relative luminance of the color as a byte value. Uses the standard formula: 0.2126R + 0.7152G + 0.0722*B

Returns

byte

The relative luminance as a byte value (0-255).

GetRelativeLuminanceF()

Calculates the relative luminance of the color as a normalized float value. Uses the standard formula: 0.2126R + 0.7152G + 0.0722*B with normalized RGB components.

public float GetRelativeLuminanceF()

Returns

float

The relative luminance as a float value (0.0-1.0).

PowLerp(ColorRgba, ColorRgba, float, float)

Performs a power-based interpolation between two colors. (expensive!) Framerate independent lerp. ExpDecayLerp(ColorRgba, ColorRgba, float, float) should be used if possible.

public static ColorRgba PowLerp(ColorRgba from, ColorRgba to, float remainder, float dt)

Parameters

from ColorRgba

The source color to interpolate from.

to ColorRgba

The target color to interpolate to.

remainder float

The remaining interpolation factor. How much fraction should remain after 1 second?

dt float

The time delta used to scale the interpolation.

Returns

ColorRgba

A new color that is the power-based interpolation between the source and target colors.

PowLerp(ColorRgba, float, float)

Performs a frame rate independent power-based interpolation from this color to another color. (expensive!) ExpDecayLerp(ColorRgba, ColorRgba, float, float) should be used if possible.

public ColorRgba PowLerp(ColorRgba to, float remainder, float dt)

Parameters

to ColorRgba

remainder float

dt float

The time delta used to scale the interpolation.

Returns

ColorRgba

A new color that is the power-based interpolation between this color and the target color.
